concept.title: Elements reference
concept.abstract: This chapter serves as a comprehensive reference to commonly used DITA elements, organized by category including block-level, inline, list, table, and admonition elements. It explains the purpose, valid topic contexts, structure, and usage patterns of each element, providing a practical foundation for authoring semantically correct, reusable, and standards-compliant DITA content. The chapter also demonstrates how specialized elements support content organization, procedural instructions, cross-references, structured data representation, and safety-critical messaging.

conbody.p: Most DITA elements used in documents can be grouped into block-level elements, admonition elements, inline elements, list elements, and table elements. Each element has its own parent topic types and purpose.
